transcript.answer: No, not any more. PR #2463 (merged 2026-10-02) added a GitHub Actions workflow, `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml`, that ran the context evals every night at 03:17 UTC. PR #2823 (merged 2026-10-19) removed that workflow. The evals had gone red three nights running (10-17, 10-18, 10-19) on a single `demo-factory-todo` document. They are now run by hand from a developer machine with `node scripts/context-evals/run.mjs` against the deployed lore-api, and nothing runs them on a schedule.
